title.zh-CN: 复视、头晕和双下肢进行性无力 · 9岁男孩
title.en: Double vision, dizziness and progressive leg weakness · 9-year-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 9岁男孩头晕、复视6天，双腿越来越无力，在别的医院治疗3天无好转后收住院。
summary.en: A 9-year-old boy is admitted after six days of dizziness, double vision and worsening leg weakness that three days of treatment elsewhere have not improved.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在与饮酒无关的情形下识别韦尼克脑病——9岁孩子出现眼征、清醒程度下降，并有营养风险（反复呕吐、偏食）——把EFNS 2010的诊断标准当作提醒而不是门槛。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise Wernicke encephalopathy outside the setting of alcohol — in a 9-year-old with eye signs, reduced alertness and a nutritional risk (recurrent vomiting, selective eating) — using the EFNS 2010 criteria as a prompt rather than a gate.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在任何含葡萄糖的液体之前、不等血药浓度或MRI，注射治疗剂量的维生素B1（EFNS 2010），并与药师按体重确定儿童剂量。
learningOutcomes.en: Give injected thiamine at a treatment dose before any glucose-containing fluid, without waiting for a level or an MRI (EFNS 2010), and agree a child's weight-based dose with the pharmacist.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 结合查体、脑脊液、新斯的明试验和MRI，把硫胺素缺乏（脑病伴双下肢无力、膝反射消失和腓肠肌压痛）与米勒-费希尔/吉兰-巴雷综合征、脑炎和重症肌无力区分开，并说明每个正常结果排除不了什么（EAN/PNS 2023）。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish thiamine deficiency (encephalopathy with weak legs, absent knee reflexes and tender calves) from Miller Fisher or Guillain–Barré syndrome, encephalitis and myasthenia using the examination, CSF, neostigmine test and MRI, stating what each normal result cannot exclude (EAN/PNS 2023).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读硫胺素缺乏的MRI表现——对称的丘脑、穹隆和深部灰质信号——并解释为什么MRI正常也不能排除诊断。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret the MRI pattern of thiamine deficiency — symmetrical thalamic, fornix and deep grey-matter signal — and explain why a normal scan would not exclude it.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为再喂养风险尚无法分级的孩子安排安全的再喂养：喂养前补充硫胺素，在逐步加量前和加量中监测钾、镁、磷（ASPEN 2020），咽反射减弱时先做吞咽筛查。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan safe refeeding for a child whose refeeding risk cannot yet be graded: thiamine before feeds, potassium, magnesium and phosphate checked before and during a gradual build-up (ASPEN 2020), and a swallow screen while the gag reflex is weak.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在缺乏未经测定时如实表述诊断——由治疗反应支持的临床诊断——并安排病因处理和神经科随访。
learningOutcomes.en: State the diagnosis honestly when the deficiency was never measured — a clinical diagnosis supported by the response — and plan treatment of the cause and neurological follow-up.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例报告改编；1.1.0版据1.0.0版记录的事实重写，尚未对照原文全文核对。保留年龄、性别、6天病程、外院按脑炎治疗3天及所用甘露醇和抗病毒药、出生第4天因肠闭锁行部分结肠切除、此后间断呕吐、发病前一周每天呕吐一次和偏食（不爱吃肉）、全部查体所见、MRI描述、脑脊液和血液检查结论、新斯的明试验、无法测定维生素B1，以及维生素B1治疗后1周和1个月的结局。姓名为化名，医院、地点和日历日期已去除，时间用相对时间。陪同家属（亲属关系未记录）、对话、人物性格、担忧、阶段、决策、处置选项、工作人员和评分为教学设计。1.0.0版中英文不一致之处（第1周结局“1周”与“within a week”；“生化”是否指脑脊液生化）两种读法都保留，留待核对原文。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case report; version 1.1.0 is rewritten from the facts recorded in version 1.0.0 and has not yet been checked against the full article. Kept: age, sex, the six-day course, three days of treatment for presumed encephalitis elsewhere and the mannitol and antiviral medicine used, a partial colectomy for intestinal atresia on day 4 of life, intermittent vomiting since, vomiting once a day in the week before onset and selective eating (does not like meat), every recorded examination finding, the MRI description, the CSF and blood conclusions, the neostigmine test, the unmeasurable vitamin B1, and the outcome one week and one month after vitamin B1. Names are pseudonyms; hospitals, places and calendar dates are removed and times are relative. The accompanying relative (relationship not recorded), dialogue, personalities, worries, phases, decisions, management options, staff and scoring are teaching design. Where 1.0.0's Chinese and English differ (the one-week outcome, “1 周” vs “within a week”; whether “biochemistry” was the CSF's) both readings are kept and listed for the source check.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 头晕、看东西重影6天，腿越来越没劲
chiefComplaint.en: Dizzy and seeing double for six days, with legs getting weaker and weaker

triageNote.zh-CN: 9岁男孩，家属陪同入院。头晕、复视、双下肢进行性无力6天，现已不能行走，精神越来越差、嗜睡；外院按脑炎治疗3天无好转。
triageNote.en: 9-year-old boy admitted with a relative. Six days of dizziness, double vision and progressive weakness of both legs; he can no longer walk and is increasingly listless and sleepy. Three days of treatment for presumed encephalitis at another hospital have not helped.

personality.zh-CN: 9岁男孩，病了6天，精神差、老想睡，只能简短回答；陪在床边的家属着急又疲惫：外院治了3天没见好，孩子现在连路都走不了。
personality.en: A 9-year-old boy six days into the illness, listless and sleepy, who manages only short answers; the relative at his bedside is anxious and worn out — three days of treatment elsewhere have not helped, and now he cannot even walk.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子话很少、说得慢，只说眼睛和头的感觉；家属用日常口语讲经过，不用医学术语，药名照医院的说法说，说不出剂量；不知道的就直说说不上来。
speechStyle.en: The boy says little, slowly, and only about his eyes and his head; the relative tells the story in everyday words without medical terms, names the medicines as the other hospital called them but cannot give doses, and says plainly when they do not know.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家属）医生，他这6天头晕、看东西重影，两条腿越来越没劲。
openingLine.en: (Relative) Doctor, for six days he's been dizzy and seeing double, and his legs keep getting weaker.

concerns.en: Will he be able to walk again?

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是脑子里出了治不好的毛病？
concerns.en: Is it something in his brain that can't be fixed?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 孩子：躺在床上，昏昏欲睡；叫他时能睁眼说几个字——看东西是两个、头晕——说完又想睡。家属：守在床边，焦急但配合，只回答被问到的内容；问到化验结果或诊断时，说要听医生的；不知道的事（体重、每天吃多少、有没有过敏、之前用的液体里有没有葡萄糖）如实说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: The boy: lying in bed, drowsy; spoken to, he opens his eyes and says a few words — things look double, his head is dizzy — then wants to sleep again. The relative: at the bedside, anxious but cooperative, answers only what is asked; asked about results or the diagnosis, says that is for the doctors; things they do not know (his weight, how much he eats, allergies, whether earlier fluids contained glucose) they say honestly they do not know — never invent them.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的家属（是哪位亲属没有记录），陪孩子住院。着急、疲惫，说话直白；知道孩子出生后不久做过肠子手术、之后时不时会吐、不爱吃肉，也知道外院按脑炎治了3天；药名只记得甘露醇和抗病毒的药，剂量说不上来；不知道的直说，不替别人猜。
persona.en: The boy's relative (which relative is not recorded), staying with him in hospital. Anxious, tired and plain-spoken; knows about the bowel operation soon after birth, the vomiting every now and then ever since and that he does not like meat, and that another hospital treated him for encephalitis for three days; remembers only mannitol and an antiviral medicine, not the doses; says plainly what they do not know and never guesses.

label.en: Admission: six days into the illness

description.zh-CN: 9岁男孩头晕、复视、双下肢进行性无力6天，外院按脑炎治疗3天无好转，由家属陪同入院。向家属和孩子了解病史，给他查体，在检查结果出来之前决定先治疗什么。
description.en: A 9-year-old boy with six days of dizziness, double vision and progressive weakness of both legs, no better after three days of treatment for presumed encephalitis at another hospital, is admitted with a relative. answer.zh-CN: 好一些了。重影和头晕都轻了，眼睛也比以前转得开了，现在能走几米。

name.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路并留取血标本
name.en: Insert an IV cannula and take blood samples

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针，同时留取血标本；如果检验科能测，在首剂维生素B1之前留一份血样备测硫胺素。
dose.en: A peripheral IV cannula, taking blood samples at the same time; if the laboratory can measure it, keep a sample for thiamine before the first dose.

response.zh-CN: 已建立静脉通路并留取血标本。本病例没有记录置管和采血的经过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: IV access is in and blood samples are taken. This case does not record the cannulation; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 注射维生素B1（硫胺素），首选静脉
name.en: Thiamine (vitamin B1) by injection, IV preferred

dose.zh-CN: 治疗剂量注射给药，先于任何含葡萄糖的液体：首选静脉（无法建立静脉通路时肌注），每日分次重复。EFNS 2010给出的成人方案为200 mg、每日3次、首选静脉；儿童剂量依据儿科处方集按体重和年龄计算，并与药师核对——他还没有称体重，不要让计算拖延首剂。床旁备好过敏反应急救用品。
dose.en: A treatment dose by injection, before any glucose-containing fluid: IV preferred (IM if IV access fails), repeated through the day. EFNS 2010 gives the adult regimen as 200 mg three times daily, preferably IV; a child's dose is worked out by weight and age from the paediatric formulary and checked with the pharmacist — he has not been weighed yet, and the calculation must not delay the first dose. Have anaphylaxis treatment to hand.

response.zh-CN: 已开始注射维生素B1。报告记录他接受了维生素B1治疗；剂量、给药途径和疗程本病例没有记录。
response.en: Thiamine by injection has been started. The report records that he was treated with vitamin B1; the dose, route and duration are not recorded in this case.

dose.zh-CN: 口服维生素B1，每日分次服用；只用于注射治疗之后、他能进食且不再呕吐时接续治疗。
dose.en: Oral vitamin B1 in divided doses each day — only to continue treatment after the injections, once he is eating and no longer vomiting.

harm.zh-CN: 疑似韦尼克脑病时，单用口服维生素B1作为首个治疗并不可靠：他反复呕吐，肠道对硫胺素的吸收量也有限。EFNS 2010指南建议治疗剂量、首选静脉给药——先注射，能进食后再改口服。
harm.en: Oral vitamin B1 alone is not a reliable first treatment for suspected Wernicke encephalopathy: he has recurrent vomiting, and gut absorption of thiamine is limited. The EFNS 2010 guideline recommends a treatment dose, preferably IV — inject first and switch to tablets once he is eating.

response.zh-CN: 已口服维生素B1。本病例没有记录是否用过口服维生素B1；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Oral vitamin B1 given. This case does not record whether oral vitamin B1 was used; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 含葡萄糖的静脉维持液

dose.zh-CN: 含葡萄糖的维持液（如10%葡萄糖加电解质），按体重计算的维持量静脉输注。
dose.en: A glucose-containing maintenance fluid (such as 10% glucose with electrolytes) by IV infusion at the maintenance rate for his weight.

harm.zh-CN: 在注射维生素B1之前开始输注葡萄糖：对可能缺乏硫胺素的孩子，葡萄糖代谢会进一步消耗所剩无几的硫胺素，可诱发或加重韦尼克脑病（EFNS 2010：在任何碳水化合物之前给硫胺素）。如果床旁血糖低，绝不能因此不给葡萄糖——应先给或同时给维生素B1。
harm.en: Glucose before injected thiamine: in a child who may be thiamine-deficient, metabolising glucose uses up what little thiamine is left and can precipitate or worsen Wernicke encephalopathy (EFNS 2010: thiamine before any carbohydrate). If his bedside glucose were low, glucose must never be withheld — give the thiamine first or alongside it.

response.zh-CN: 已开始输液。本病例没有记录他的补液、血糖和电解质；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. This case does not record his fluids, glucose or electrolytes; it does not simulate their effect.

name.en: Glucose-free isotonic IV fluid (0.9% sodium chloride)

dose.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠静脉输注，速度按体重和液体状态决定。
dose.en: 0.9% sodium chloride by IV infusion, at a rate set by his weight and fluid status.

response.zh-CN: 已开始输液。本病例没有记录他的补液；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. This case does not record his fluids; it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉甘露醇（继续此前的治疗）

dose.zh-CN: 甘露醇静脉滴注，按体重给药。

response.zh-CN: 已给甘露醇。他此前用过甘露醇（剂量本病例没有记录），治疗后并未好转；本病例没有颅内压增高的记录，不模拟甘露醇的效果。甘露醇是渗透性利尿剂，对反复呕吐、偏食的孩子会加重液体和电解质丢失。
response.en: Mannitol given. He had received mannitol before (the dose is not recorded in this case) without improvement; this case records no sign of raised intracranial pressure and does not simulate the effect. Mannitol is an osmotic diuretic: in a child with recurrent vomiting and selective eating it adds to fluid and electrolyte losses.

name.zh-CN: 静脉阿昔洛韦（抗病毒治疗）

dose.zh-CN: 阿昔洛韦静脉滴注，按年龄和体重给药，每8小时一次，注意肾功能。
dose.en: IV aciclovir dosed by age and weight, every 8 hours, with attention to renal function.

response.zh-CN: 已给阿昔洛韦。他此前用过抗病毒药（药名和剂量本病例没有记录）。按ABN/BPAIIG 2012儿童脑炎指南，免疫功能正常的儿童一旦作出其他诊断即可停用阿昔洛韦；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Aciclovir given. He had already received an antiviral medicine (its name and dose are not recorded in this case). The ABN/BPAIIG 2012 guideline on encephalitis in children lets aciclovir stop in an immunocompetent child once an alternative diagnosis has been made; this case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉注射人免疫球蛋白

dose.zh-CN: 静注人免疫球蛋白0.4 g/kg，每日1次，连用5天（总量2 g/kg）。
dose.en: IV immunoglobulin 0.4 g/kg once daily for 5 days (2 g/kg in total).

harm.zh-CN: 在给维生素B1之前先用免疫球蛋白，是把病情锚定在吉兰-巴雷/米勒-费希尔综合征上：它解释不了他的嗜睡和营养风险，却让可逆的病因得不到治疗，还让他承受血液制品的风险。EAN/PNS 2023指南对起病2周内不能独立行走的吉兰-巴雷综合征使用免疫球蛋白；这里应先给维生素B1，同时继续评估吉兰-巴雷综合征。
harm.en: IVIG before thiamine anchors on Guillain–Barré or Miller Fisher syndrome: it does not explain his drowsiness or his nutritional risk, leaves the reversible cause untreated and exposes him to a blood product. The EAN/PNS 2023 guideline gives IVIG for Guillain–Barré syndrome to patients unable to walk unaided within 2 weeks of onset; here, give thiamine first and keep Guillain–Barré syndrome under review.

response.zh-CN: 已开始静注人免疫球蛋白。本病例没有记录使用免疫球蛋白；不模拟其效果。
response.en: IVIG started. This case does not record IVIG; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 经口进食前做床旁吞咽筛查
name.en: Bedside swallow screen before anything by mouth

dose.zh-CN: 经口进食、饮水或口服药物前，由经过培训的护士做床旁吞咽筛查；不通过则暂禁经口，请言语治疗师评估。
dose.en: Before any food, drink or oral medicine, a trained nurse screens his swallow at the bedside; if he fails, nothing by mouth until a speech and language therapist assesses him.

response.zh-CN: 已安排吞咽筛查。本病例没有记录是否做过；不模拟其结果。
response.en: Swallow screen arranged. This case does not record whether it was done; it does not simulate the result.

name.zh-CN: 请儿科营养师会诊：营养评估和喂养计划
name.en: Refer to the paediatric dietitian for a nutrition assessment and feeding plan

dose.zh-CN: 评估营养状况和摄入，制定逐步加量的喂养计划，处理偏食。
dose.en: Assess his nutrition and intake, plan a gradual build-up of feeds and address the selective eating.

response.zh-CN: 已请营养师会诊。本病例没有记录营养评估；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Dietetic review requested. This case does not record a nutrition assessment; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 定时神经系统观察：意识、瞳孔和眼球运动
name.en: Regular neurological observations: conscious level, pupils and eye movements

dose.zh-CN: 按病情定时记录意识水平、瞳孔和眼球运动，恶化时立即报告医生。
dose.en: Record his conscious level, pupils and eye movements at set intervals, and call the doctor at once if they worsen.

response.zh-CN: 已开始定时观察。本病例没有记录他的观察结果；不模拟。
response.en: Observations started. This case does not record his observations; they are not simulated.

name.zh-CN: 请小儿外科和消化科查找长期呕吐的原因
name.en: Ask paediatric surgery and gastroenterology to find the cause of his long-standing vomiting

dose.zh-CN: 评估新生儿期结肠部分切除术后的情况和长期间断呕吐的原因。
dose.en: Assess the after-effects of his neonatal partial colectomy and the cause of his long-standing intermittent vomiting.

response.zh-CN: 已请会诊。本病例没有记录这次会诊或其结果；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Review requested. This case does not record this referral or what it found; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 安排神经科随访：复查MRI并评估记忆和学习
name.en: Arrange neurology follow-up with a repeat MRI and a check of memory and learning

dose.zh-CN: 出院后神经科门诊随访，复查MRI，评估记忆、学习和下肢功能。
dose.en: Neurology clinic after discharge, a repeat MRI, and a check of memory, learning and leg function.

response.zh-CN: 已安排随访。本病例记录的随访到1个月为止；此后的随访和记忆、学习评估没有记录。
response.en: Follow-up arranged. The follow-up this case records ends at one month; nothing after it, and no assessment of memory or learning, is recorded.

title.zh-CN: 听家属和孩子讲这次的病
title.en: Hear the story of this illness

hint.zh-CN: 症状是怎样开始、怎样发展的？在别处做过什么治疗，效果如何？
hint.en: How did it begin and how has it changed? What has been tried elsewhere, and did it help?

guidance.zh-CN: 家属回答病史；看东西和头晕的感觉，可以直接问孩子。
guidance.en: His relative gives the history; ask the boy himself how his eyes and his head feel.

title.zh-CN: 了解他平时的进食和既往情况
title.en: Find out how he usually eats and what he has had before

hint.zh-CN: 在这6天之前很久，可能有什么一直在悄悄影响他？
hint.en: Long before these six days, what might have been quietly wearing him down?

guidance.zh-CN: 问一问他出生以来的情况、平时的胃口和身体。
guidance.en: Ask about his life since birth, his appetite and his health in general.

title.zh-CN: 检查眼睛、双腿和清醒程度
title.en: Examine his eyes, his legs and how alert he is

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能把眼睛、清醒程度和双腿的问题连成一个诊断？
hint.en: Which signs could tie his eyes, his alertness and his legs into one diagnosis?

guidance.en: He is lying in bed, drowsy.

hint.zh-CN: 哪个诊断一旦漏掉会留下永久损害，而治疗它的代价又很小？
hint.en: Which diagnosis would leave lasting damage if it were missed, yet costs very little to treat?

guidance.zh-CN: 检查结果还没有出来，先在床旁作出判断。
guidance.en: No result is back yet: decide at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 解读入院检查并安排补液和喂养
title.en: Interpret the work-up and plan fluids and feeding

hint.zh-CN: 每一项结果支持什么、排除了什么、又排除不了什么？恢复进食时最先可能出什么问题？
hint.en: What does each result support, what does it rule out, and what can it not rule out? What could go wrong first as he starts eating again?

guidance.zh-CN: MRI、脑脊液、血液检查和新斯的明试验的报告已在病历里。
guidance.en: The MRI, CSF, blood and neostigmine test reports are in his notes.

hint.zh-CN: 他的好转说明了什么、没说明什么？接下来还有什么没有解决？
hint.en: What does his improvement show, what does it not show, and what is still left to sort out?

guidance.zh-CN: 治疗第1周的病程记录可以调阅；全部决策完成后，可以查看1个月随访和已报告的结局。
guidance.en: The first week's progress notes are in the chart; once every decision is made, the one-month review and the reported outcome open.

prompt.zh-CN: 9岁男孩头晕、复视6天，双下肢无力逐渐加重到不能行走，精神越来越差、嗜睡；外院按脑炎治疗3天无好转。他出生第4天因肠闭锁切除过一段结肠，此后时常呕吐，发病前一周每天呕吐，不爱吃肉。查体：双侧上睑下垂，眼球内收、外展受限，水平及垂直眼震；双下肢肌力Ⅲ级，膝反射未引出，腓肠肌压痛。在任何检查结果回报之前，哪个工作诊断应当决定你的下一步？
prompt.en: A 9-year-old boy has had six days of dizziness and double vision; his legs have weakened until he cannot walk, and he is increasingly listless and sleepy. Three days of treatment for presumed encephalitis elsewhere have not helped. Part of his colon was removed for intestinal atresia on day 4 of life, he has vomited on and off ever since, he vomited daily in the week before this began, and he does not like meat. He has bilateral ptosis, restricted adduction and abduction with horizontal and vertical nystagmus, leg power grade III, absent knee reflexes and calf tenderness. Before any result is back, which working diagnosis should drive your next step?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次的病程和外院治疗、他长期的呕吐和饮食，并检查眼睑、眼球运动、神志、下肢肌力、反射和小腿。
need.en: First take the story of this illness and the earlier treatment, his long-standing vomiting and his diet, and examine his eyelids, eye movements, alertness, leg power, reflexes and calves.

text.zh-CN: 维生素B1（硫胺素）缺乏所致的韦尼克脑病，可能合并周围神经病变：现在就按此治疗，其他病因同时继续查
text.en: Wernicke encephalopathy from thiamine deficiency, probably with a peripheral neuropathy: treat it now while the other causes are still being worked up

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。眼征（上睑下垂、眼外肌麻痹、眼震）和清醒程度下降（精神差、嗜睡），再加上缺乏的理由——新生儿期手术后时常呕吐、发病前一周每天呕吐、不爱吃肉——应首先考虑硫胺素缺乏。韦尼克脑病并不只见于饮酒者：EFNS 2010指南要求在任何可能导致硫胺素缺乏的情况下都要想到它，一旦怀疑就给予硫胺素、不等确诊——治疗安全、便宜，延误却可能留下永久的记忆和神经损害。双下肢无力伴膝反射消失和腓肠肌压痛，提示可能同时存在硫胺素缺乏性周围神经病；吉兰-巴雷/米勒-费希尔综合征仍是需要同时排查的主要鉴别。
feedback.en: Right. Eye signs (ptosis, eye-movement palsy, nystagmus) and reduced alertness (listless, sleepy) in a child with reasons to be deficient — vomiting on and off since his neonatal operation, vomiting every day in the week before onset, a dislike of meat — put thiamine deficiency first. Wernicke encephalopathy is not only a disease of alcohol: the EFNS 2010 guideline asks for it to be suspected in any condition that can lead to thiamine deficiency, and for thiamine as soon as it is suspected, without waiting for proof — the treatment is safe and cheap, while delay can leave permanent memory and neurological damage. Weak legs with absent knee reflexes and calf tenderness suggest a thiamine-deficiency neuropathy as well; Guillain–Barré and Miller Fisher syndromes remain the main differential to pursue alongside.

text.zh-CN: 米勒-费希尔/吉兰-巴雷重叠综合征：眼肌麻痹、膝反射消失加双下肢无力，首先安排静脉注射免疫球蛋白
text.en: Miller Fisher–Guillain–Barré overlap: ophthalmoplegia, absent knee reflexes and leg weakness, so the first treatment to arrange is IV immunoglobulin

feedback.zh-CN: 这是最重要的鉴别，但不是应当先治疗的诊断。米勒-费希尔综合征表现为眼肌麻痹、共济失调和腱反射消失，通常不伴嗜睡——而他的指鼻试验稳准——也解释不了他的营养风险。EAN/PNS 2023指南对起病2周内不能独立行走的吉兰-巴雷综合征使用免疫球蛋白，但先给安全的维生素B1并不妨碍这一选择；反过来，先用免疫球蛋白却可能耽误一个可逆的病因。
feedback.en: This is the key differential, but not the diagnosis to treat first. Miller Fisher syndrome combines ophthalmoplegia, ataxia and areflexia, usually without drowsiness — and his finger–nose test was accurate — and it does not explain his nutritional risk. The EAN/PNS 2023 guideline gives IV immunoglobulin for Guillain–Barré syndrome to patients unable to walk unaided within 2 weeks of onset, but giving safe thiamine first costs that option nothing, whereas IVIG first may cost a reversible cause.

text.zh-CN: 抗病毒治疗尚未起效的病毒性脑炎：继续抗病毒药和甘露醇，等脑脊液和MRI结果回来再调整方案
text.en: Viral encephalitis that has not yet responded to the antiviral: continue the antiviral and mannitol, and adjust the plan once the CSF and MRI are back

feedback.zh-CN: 外院按脑炎治疗3天已经毫无起色，继续原方案、等结果只会延长延误。脑炎解释不了膝反射消失和腓肠肌压痛，也解释不了他的营养风险；ABN/BPAIIG 2012儿童脑炎指南建议治疗无好转的患儿转入儿童神经专科，并允许在作出其他诊断后停用阿昔洛韦。对一个有营养风险、出现眼征和嗜睡的孩子，先给维生素B1。
feedback.en: Three days of encephalitis treatment elsewhere have already failed, and continuing the same plan while waiting for results only extends the delay. Encephalitis does not explain absent knee reflexes, calf tenderness or his nutritional risk; the ABN/BPAIIG 2012 guideline on encephalitis in children advises transfer to a paediatric neurology unit when a child fails to improve, and lets aciclovir stop once an alternative diagnosis has been made. In a child with nutritional risk, eye signs and drowsiness, give thiamine first.

text.zh-CN: 重症肌无力：上睑下垂、眼球运动受限伴肢体无力，先做新斯的明试验，阳性就开始口服溴吡斯的明
text.en: Myasthenia gravis: ptosis and restricted eye movements with limb weakness, so do a neostigmine test and start oral pyridostigmine if it is positive

feedback.zh-CN: 重症肌无力可以有上睑下垂和眼外肌麻痹，但不会引起嗜睡、腱反射消失或腓肠肌压痛。眼征和意识改变，加上很可能存在的饮食缺乏——都是EFNS 2010诊断标准中的体征——指向硫胺素缺乏。新斯的明试验可以做，但不应排在维生素B1之前。
feedback.en: Myasthenia gravis can cause ptosis and eye-movement palsy, but not drowsiness, absent reflexes or calf tenderness. Eye signs and an altered mental state, with a likely dietary deficiency — signs from the EFNS 2010 criteria — point to thiamine deficiency. A neostigmine test can still be done, but not ahead of thiamine.

text.zh-CN: 脑干脑炎（Bickerstaff型）或急性播散性脑脊髓炎：嗜睡伴眼肌麻痹，先用大剂量甲泼尼龙静脉冲击
text.en: Brainstem (Bickerstaff) encephalitis or acute disseminated encephalomyelitis: drowsiness with ophthalmoplegia, so start high-dose IV methylprednisolone

feedback.zh-CN: 嗜睡伴眼肌麻痹确实要想到脑干脑炎和急性播散性脑脊髓炎，但两者都解释不了他的营养风险和腓肠肌压痛；在影像出来之前就做激素冲击，会让可逆的硫胺素缺乏继续得不到治疗。EFNS 2010指南：怀疑韦尼克脑病时，先给硫胺素。
feedback.en: Drowsiness with ophthalmoplegia does raise brainstem encephalitis and ADEM, but neither explains his nutritional risk or his calf tenderness, and pulse steroids before any imaging leave a reversible thiamine deficiency untreated. The EFNS 2010 guideline: when Wernicke encephalopathy is suspected, give thiamine first.

prompt.zh-CN: 你按维生素B1缺乏处理这个反复呕吐、还没有称过体重的9岁孩子。维生素B1怎么给？
prompt.en: You are treating suspected thiamine deficiency in a 9-year-old with recurrent vomiting who has not yet been weighed. How do you give the thiamine?

need.zh-CN: 先作出床旁工作诊断（决策 1）。
need.en: Make the bedside working diagnosis first (Decision 1).

text.zh-CN: 现在就注射给药（首选静脉），治疗剂量每日分次重复，先于任何含葡萄糖的液体；称体重定剂量，但不等化验
text.en: By injection now (IV if possible), a treatment dose repeated through the day and before any glucose-containing fluid; weigh him, but do not wait for a level

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。EFNS 2010指南：疑似韦尼克脑病时在任何碳水化合物之前给予硫胺素，用治疗剂量、首选静脉（成人200 mg、每日3次）；能检测时在首剂前即刻留血样测血硫胺素——但绝不能因此延误。儿童剂量没有统一标准，按体重计算并与药师核对——先称体重，但不要让计算拖延首剂。
feedback.en: Right. The EFNS 2010 guideline: in suspected Wernicke encephalopathy give thiamine before any carbohydrate, at a treatment dose and preferably IV (adults 200 mg three times daily), and measure blood thiamine on a sample taken immediately before the first dose where the test exists — but never at the cost of delay. Children's doses are not standardised: calculate by weight and check with the pharmacist — weigh him, but do not let the calculation hold up the first dose.

text.zh-CN: 随餐口服维生素B1片，每日3次，同时请营养师调整饮食；如果1周后仍不见好转，再改为静脉给药
text.en: Vitamin B1 tablets by mouth three times a day with meals and a dietitian to correct his diet, switching to IV thiamine only if he is no better after a week

feedback.zh-CN: 口服在这里并不可靠：他反复呕吐，肠道对硫胺素的吸收量有限，补充剂量也远低于治疗剂量。EFNS 2010指南建议治疗剂量、首选静脉，口服只用于能进食后接续治疗；等1周再改静脉，可能让眼征和嗜睡发展成不可逆的损害。
feedback.en: Tablets are unreliable here: he has recurrent vomiting, gut absorption of thiamine is limited, and supplement doses are far below treatment doses. The EFNS 2010 guideline recommends a treatment dose, preferably IV, with tablets only to continue once he is eating; waiting a week to switch risks letting the eye signs and drowsiness become permanent damage.

text.zh-CN: 先抽血送检维生素B1水平，等结果证实缺乏后再开始注射，避免在没有化验证据的情况下给一个孩子用药
text.en: Send a blood thiamine level first and start the injections once a low result confirms the deficiency, so that a child is not treated without laboratory evidence

feedback.zh-CN: 即使能测，结果也要等，而且这里根本测不了维生素B1。EFNS 2010指南建议在首剂前即刻留取血样，但治疗不等结果：硫胺素安全，延误的代价大。先治疗，治疗反应本身也会成为诊断依据。
feedback.en: Even where a level can be measured the result takes time, and here vitamin B1 cannot be measured at all. The EFNS 2010 guideline advises taking the sample immediately before the first dose but does not wait for the result: thiamine is safe and delay is costly. Treat now; the response itself becomes part of the evidence.

text.zh-CN: 他反复呕吐又偏食，先开通静脉输10%葡萄糖维持液纠正摄入不足，等液体输上以后再静脉推注一次维生素B1
text.en: With his vomiting and fussy eating, start a 10% glucose maintenance drip to correct his intake first, and give one IV dose of thiamine once that drip is running

feedback.zh-CN: 顺序反了：先输葡萄糖会进一步消耗所剩无几的硫胺素，可能诱发或加重韦尼克脑病。EFNS 2010指南要求在任何碳水化合物之前给硫胺素，而且是每日分次的治疗剂量，不是一次。若床旁血糖低，绝不能不给葡萄糖——但应先给或同时给维生素B1。
feedback.en: The order is wrong: glucose first uses up what little thiamine is left and can precipitate or worsen Wernicke encephalopathy. The EFNS 2010 guideline asks for thiamine before any carbohydrate, and as a repeated treatment dose, not one shot. If his glucose were low, glucose must never be withheld — but give the thiamine first or at the same time.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院检查结果：头颅MRI示双侧丘脑、豆状核及穹隆对称性异常信号，FLAIR呈高信号，豆状核DWI信号稍高；脑脊液常规、生化正常；血常规和肌酶无明显异常；新斯的明试验阴性；维生素B1无法定量。这些结果能让你得出什么结论？
prompt.en: The admission work-up: the brain MRI shows symmetrical abnormal signal in both thalami, the lentiform nuclei and the fornix, high on FLAIR, with slightly high DWI signal in the lentiform nuclei; routine CSF and CSF biochemistry are normal; the blood count and muscle enzymes show no obvious abnormality; the neostigmine test is negative; vitamin B1 could not be measured. What can you conclude?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅MRI、脑脊液、血常规、肌酶、新斯的明试验和维生素B1检测的结果。
need.en: Read the MRI, CSF, blood count, muscle enzyme, neostigmine test and vitamin B1 results first.

text.zh-CN: 支持诊断：对称的丘脑、穹隆和豆状核信号符合硫胺素缺乏，其余结果不支持感染和重症肌无力，但早期脑脊液正常排除不了吉兰-巴雷
text.en: They support it: symmetrical thalamic, fornix and lentiform signal fits thiamine deficiency, the other results weigh against infection and myasthenia, but an early normal CSF cannot exclude Guillain–Barré

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。EFNS 2010指南建议在饮酒和不饮酒的患者中都用MRI来支持诊断。典型部位是丘脑内侧、乳头体、顶盖和导水管周围区域；基底节等不典型部位主要见于与饮酒无关的患者（Zuccoli和Pipitone 2009）——他的豆状核信号就属于这一类；但MRI正常也不能排除诊断。脑脊液正常、新斯的明试验阴性使感染和重症肌无力的可能变小，但不是不可能。EAN/PNS 2023指南建议用电生理检查支持吉兰-巴雷综合征的诊断，而早期脑脊液蛋白仍可正常：若治疗后无力不见好转，应做神经传导检查。
feedback.en: Right. The EFNS 2010 guideline uses MRI to support the diagnosis in people who drink and in those who do not. The typical sites are the medial thalami, mammillary bodies, tectal plate and periaqueductal area; atypical sites such as the basal ganglia are reported mainly in patients without alcohol use (Zuccoli and Pipitone 2009) — his lentiform signal is one — and a normal MRI would not have excluded it. A normal CSF and a negative neostigmine test make infection and myasthenia less likely, not impossible. The EAN/PNS 2023 guideline advises electrodiagnostic testing to support Guillain–Barré syndrome, whose CSF protein can still be normal early: if his weakness does not improve on treatment, he needs nerve conduction studies.

text.zh-CN: 儿童双侧对称的基底节和丘脑病灶提示线粒体病（Leigh样）：送血乳酸和基因检测，在结果回来之前先停用维生素B1，以免掩盖诊断
text.en: Symmetrical basal ganglia and thalamic lesions in a child point to a mitochondrial (Leigh-type) disorder: send lactate and genetic tests, and stop the vitamins until the results return so that nothing is masked

feedback.zh-CN: 对称性深部灰质病灶确实要想到Leigh综合征和硫胺素转运体缺陷，但停用维生素B1是错的：它安全，能治疗韦尼克脑病，对硫胺素反应性基底节病也是治疗的一部分。EFNS 2010指南：怀疑即治疗。只有在治疗反应差或反复发作时，才需要进一步做代谢和基因检查。
feedback.en: Symmetrical deep grey-matter lesions do raise Leigh syndrome and the thiamine-transporter disorders, but stopping thiamine is wrong: it is safe, it treats Wernicke encephalopathy, and it is part of the treatment of thiamine-responsive basal ganglia disease too. The EFNS 2010 guideline: treat on suspicion. Metabolic and genetic tests are for a poor response or a recurrence.

text.zh-CN: 双侧丘脑对称性信号异常首先要按大脑深静脉血栓处理：立即开始抗凝，再安排磁共振静脉成像来确认诊断，同时继续观察意识变化
text.en: Symmetrical bilateral thalamic signal is deep cerebral venous thrombosis until proven otherwise: start anticoagulation now, arrange MR venography to confirm it and keep watching his conscious level

feedback.zh-CN: 大脑深静脉血栓可以引起双侧丘脑病灶，有疑问时可用磁共振静脉成像排除；但没有影像证据就抗凝有出血风险，而且血栓解释不了眼肌麻痹伴膝反射消失和腓肠肌压痛，也解释不了他的营养风险。疑似韦尼克脑病应一经怀疑即给予硫胺素（EFNS 2010）。
feedback.en: Deep cerebral venous thrombosis can cause bilateral thalamic lesions, and MR venography can exclude it if doubt remains; but anticoagulating without imaging proof risks bleeding, and thrombosis would not explain the eye-movement palsy with absent knee reflexes and calf tenderness, or his nutritional risk. Suspected Wernicke encephalopathy is treated with thiamine on suspicion (EFNS 2010).

text.zh-CN: 脑脊液正常排除了吉兰-巴雷和米勒-费希尔综合征，新斯的明试验阴性排除了重症肌无力，诊断已经明确，不必再做神经传导或抗体检查
text.en: The normal CSF excludes Guillain–Barré and Miller Fisher syndromes and the negative neostigmine test excludes myasthenia, so the diagnosis is settled and no nerve conduction or antibody tests are needed

feedback.zh-CN: 这两个结论都说得太满。EAN/PNS 2023指南靠电生理检查而不是正常的脑脊液来支持吉兰-巴雷综合征的诊断——早期脑脊液蛋白可以正常——并建议怀疑米勒-费希尔综合征时检测抗GQ1b抗体；新斯的明试验阴性也不能完全排除重症肌无力。目前的诊断是有力的临床判断，要用治疗反应来检验；若无力不见好转，仍需做神经传导和抗神经节苷脂抗体检查。
feedback.en: That overstates both results. The EAN/PNS 2023 guideline relies on electrodiagnostic testing, not a normal CSF, to support Guillain–Barré syndrome — CSF protein can be normal early — and advises anti-GQ1b antibody testing when Miller Fisher syndrome is suspected; a negative neostigmine test does not fully exclude myasthenia either. The diagnosis is a strong clinical judgement to be tested by his response; if the weakness does not improve, nerve conduction studies and anti-ganglioside antibodies are still needed.

text.zh-CN: 没有测到维生素B1水平就不能诊断硫胺素缺乏：在能把血样送到外院检测之前先停用维生素B1，不要让治疗反应代替证据
text.en: Without a measured vitamin B1 level thiamine deficiency cannot be diagnosed: stop the vitamin B1 until a sample can be sent elsewhere, rather than let the response stand in for proof

feedback.zh-CN: 测不到水平不是停药的理由。EFNS 2010指南建议在首剂前留血样测血硫胺素，但从不等结果；在无法检测时，诊断依靠临床表现、影像和治疗反应，并在病历中如实写明。停用维生素B1可能让可逆的损害变成永久性。
feedback.en: An unmeasurable level is no reason to stop. The EFNS 2010 guideline asks for blood thiamine to be measured on a sample taken before the first dose, but it never waits for the result; where the test is unavailable, the diagnosis rests on the clinical picture, the imaging and the response, recorded honestly as such. Stopping thiamine could let reversible damage become permanent.

prompt.zh-CN: 他多年来时常呕吐，不爱吃肉，体重没有记录，咽反射稍弱。维生素B1已经安排上之后，你怎样安全地恢复补液和营养？
prompt.en: He has vomited on and off for years, does not like meat, has no recorded weight and has a slightly weak gag reflex. Once thiamine is under way, how do you restart fluids and nutrition safely?

need.zh-CN: 先决定维生素B1的给法（决策 2），并检查咽反射。
need.en: Decide how to give the thiamine (Decision 2) and check his gag reflex first.

text.zh-CN: 先查血糖、钾、镁、磷，加量期间复查；经口进食前做吞咽筛查；称体重，与营养师一起逐步加量，维生素B1继续用
text.en: Check glucose, potassium, magnesium and phosphate and repeat them as intake rises; screen his swallow first; weigh him and build feeds up gradually with the dietitian, thiamine continuing

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。在称体重、弄清摄入量之前，无法给他的再喂养风险分级，所以先按有风险处理。ASPEN 2020再喂养综合征共识：有风险的儿童在开始喂养或输含葡萄糖液体之前补充硫胺素，喂养前查钾、镁、磷并在最初3天反复监测，热量从低于目标量开始逐步增加。镁是硫胺素依赖酶的辅因子，低镁会削弱硫胺素的疗效。他咽反射稍弱，经口进食前先做吞咽筛查。
feedback.en: Right. His refeeding risk cannot be graded until he is weighed and his intake is known, so treat him as at risk. The ASPEN 2020 consensus on refeeding syndrome: in an at-risk child give thiamine before feeds or dextrose-containing fluid, check potassium, magnesium and phosphate before feeding and repeatedly over the first 3 days, and start below the energy goal and build up gradually. Magnesium is a cofactor for thiamine-dependent enzymes, so a low magnesium blunts the response to thiamine. With a slightly weak gag, his swallow is screened before anything by mouth.

text.zh-CN: 尽快把欠下的营养补回来：今天起给足量的高能量饮食，再加用高浓度葡萄糖静脉输注，争取出院前把营养补足，电解质等他吃好了再查
text.en: Make up the deficit fast: full-energy meals from today plus a concentrated glucose infusion so that he has caught up before discharge, with his electrolytes checked once he is eating well

feedback.zh-CN: 快速追补正是再喂养综合征的诱因：大量热量和葡萄糖会使钾、磷、镁向细胞内转移，并加快消耗硫胺素。ASPEN 2020共识要求对有风险的儿童逐步增加热量，在最初几天监测电解质，而不是等吃好了再查。
feedback.en: Rapid catch-up is exactly what triggers refeeding syndrome: a large energy and glucose load drives potassium, phosphate and magnesium into cells and uses up thiamine faster. The ASPEN 2020 consensus asks for energy to be built up gradually in an at-risk child, with electrolytes monitored over the first days — not once he is eating well.

text.zh-CN: 为了保护气道，禁食一周，只输普通葡萄糖维持液，等复查MRI病灶消退、咽反射恢复正常以后再开始经口进食
text.en: Protect his airway: nil by mouth for a week on plain glucose maintenance fluid, starting oral feeds only once a repeat MRI shows the lesions have gone and his gag reflex is normal

feedback.zh-CN: 禁食一周只输葡萄糖会加重营养不良，单纯葡萄糖对硫胺素缺乏的孩子也不安全。咽反射稍弱需要的是吞咽筛查，必要时请言语治疗师评估，而不是一刀切地禁食；ASPEN 2020共识主张在监测下尽早、逐步恢复营养，MRI病灶消退也不是开始进食的标准。
feedback.en: A week nil by mouth on plain glucose deepens the malnutrition, and glucose alone is not safe for a thiamine-deficient child. A slightly weak gag calls for a swallow screen and, if needed, a speech and language assessment, not a blanket fast; the ASPEN 2020 consensus favours an early, gradual, monitored return of nutrition, and MRI resolution is no criterion for feeding.

text.zh-CN: 咽反射只是稍弱，今天就恢复正常饮食，鼓励他多吃肉、多吃饭；电解质等他出现不适时再复查，也不必请营养师
text.en: His gag is only slightly weak, so restart a normal diet by mouth today and encourage plenty of meat and rice; recheck electrolytes only if he becomes unwell, with no need for the dietitian

feedback.zh-CN: 咽反射稍弱时未经筛查就恢复经口进食有误吸风险；不监测电解质就开始喂养，会错过再喂养综合征的早期信号（ASPEN 2020共识）。营养师的作用不只是让他多吃，而是评估营养状况、制定逐步加量的方案并处理偏食。
feedback.en: Restarting food by mouth with a weak gag and no swallow screen risks aspiration, and feeding without electrolyte monitoring misses the early signs of refeeding syndrome (ASPEN 2020 consensus). The dietitian's job is not just “eat more” but to assess his nutrition, plan a gradual build-up and address the selective eating.

prompt.zh-CN: 开始维生素B1后1周，他的复视、头晕和眼球运动都有改善，能走几米了。你怎样表述诊断，下一步怎么安排？
prompt.en: By a week after vitamin B1 was started, his double vision, dizziness and eye movements had improved and he could walk a few metres. How do you state the diagnosis, and what comes next?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅治疗第1周的病程记录。
need.en: Read the progress notes for the first week of treatment first.

text.zh-CN: 临床诊断硫胺素缺乏，治疗反应支持但没有测得水平：继续维生素B1，能进食且不吐后改口服，查找呕吐和偏食的原因，并安排随访
text.en: A clinical diagnosis of thiamine deficiency, supported by the response but never measured: continue thiamine (by mouth once he eats without vomiting), find the cause of the vomiting and diet, and follow him up

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。没有测得维生素B1，诊断应如实写成临床诊断：眼征、嗜睡、营养风险、MRI表现和治疗后迅速好转共同支持它，但不是实验室确诊。好转期间继续治疗，能进食且不吐后改口服。他长期呕吐和偏食的原因（包括新生儿期肠道手术后的情况）需要外科、消化科和营养师评估：EFNS 2010要求在一切可能导致硫胺素缺乏的情况下都想到韦尼克脑病，而他的这些情况仍然存在。记忆和学习也需要随访。
feedback.en: Right. With no level measured, write it honestly as a clinical diagnosis: eye signs, drowsiness, nutritional risk, the MRI and a quick response support it, but it is not laboratory-proven. Keep treating while he improves, by mouth once he eats without vomiting. The cause of his long-standing vomiting and selective eating — including the after-effects of his neonatal bowel operation — needs surgical, gastroenterology and dietetic review: EFNS 2010 asks for Wernicke encephalopathy to be suspected in every condition that can lead to thiamine deficiency, and his still can. His memory and learning need follow-up too.

text.zh-CN: 治疗反应已经证实了诊断，1周的注射也已经补足了体内储备：停用维生素B1，恢复普通饮食后出院，不需要专门的随访安排
text.en: The response proves the diagnosis and a week of injections has refilled his stores: stop the thiamine, discharge him on an ordinary diet and arrange no particular follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 1周的好转只是开始：下肢肌力还在恢复，导致缺乏的原因（长期呕吐、偏食）也还在，停药可能导致再次缺乏——好转期间应继续治疗，并处理病因。“证实”也说过了头：没有测得水平，这是建立在EFNS 2010指南所依据的临床表现和MRI之上的有力临床诊断，不是实验室证据。
feedback.en: A week's improvement is only the start: his legs are still recovering and the causes — long-standing vomiting and selective eating — are still there, so stopping invites relapse; keep treating while he improves and deal with the cause. And “proves” overstates it: with no level measured, this is a strong clinical diagnosis built on the clinical picture and the MRI that the EFNS 2010 guideline relies on, not laboratory proof.

text.zh-CN: 治疗有效证明病因就是新生儿期结肠切除造成的吸收不良：终身大剂量口服维生素B1就够了，长期呕吐不必再查，饮食也不必再调整
text.en: The response proves that malabsorption from his neonatal colon resection is the cause: lifelong high-dose oral thiamine is all he needs, and the long-standing vomiting and selective diet need no further work-up

feedback.zh-CN: 硫胺素主要在小肠（空肠）吸收，部分结肠切除本身并不能解释吸收不良——除非当年手术也涉及小肠，而这一点没有记录。更直接的原因是多年间断呕吐和偏食，这些都还需要查明和处理。EFNS 2010指南特别提到的手术情形是减重手术，它绕过了吸收硫胺素的上段肠道。把那次手术当作已证实的病因可能漏掉可治疗的问题，而治疗反应只能支持诊断，证明不了具体机制。
feedback.en: Thiamine is absorbed mainly in the small intestine (jejunum), so a partial colon resection does not by itself explain malabsorption — unless the operation also involved his small bowel, which is not recorded. The more direct causes are years of intermittent vomiting and selective eating, which still need finding and treating. The surgical setting the EFNS 2010 guideline singles out is bariatric surgery, which bypasses the upper gut where thiamine is absorbed. Calling his operation a proven cause could miss something treatable, and a response supports the diagnosis without proving a mechanism.

text.zh-CN: 下肢恢复比眼征慢，说明其实是吉兰-巴雷综合征：停用维生素B1，改用静脉注射免疫球蛋白，并复查腰椎穿刺
text.en: His legs are recovering more slowly than his eyes, so this was Guillain–Barré syndrome after all: stop the thiamine, give IV immunoglobulin and repeat the lumbar puncture

feedback.zh-CN: 眼征先好转、下肢恢复较慢，正是硫胺素缺乏常见的恢复顺序：周围神经的修复需要更长时间。停用维生素B1会打断恢复；EAN/PNS 2023指南的免疫球蛋白治疗针对吉兰-巴雷综合征，而这里的病程和治疗反应并不支持它。若数周后无力仍无进展，再做神经传导检查。
feedback.en: Eye signs improving before the legs is the usual order of recovery in thiamine deficiency: peripheral nerves take longer to repair. Stopping thiamine would interrupt that recovery, and the EAN/PNS 2023 guideline's IVIG is for Guillain–Barré syndrome, which this course and response do not support. If the weakness stalled over the following weeks, nerve conduction studies would be the next step.

text.zh-CN: 问清病程（头晕、复视、双腿无力、嗜睡）、外院治疗和用药，以及长期呕吐、发病前呕吐、偏食和新生儿期肠道手术
text.en: Took the course (dizziness, double vision, leg weakness, drowsiness), the earlier treatment and medicines, and the long-standing vomiting, vomiting before onset, selective diet and neonatal bowel operation

text.zh-CN: 检查了眼睑、眼球运动、神志、下肢肌力、膝反射和病理征、腓肠肌和咽反射
text.en: Examined the eyelids, eye movements, alertness, leg power, knee and pathological reflexes, calves and gag reflex

text.zh-CN: 调阅了MRI、脑脊液、新斯的明试验和肌酶结果
text.en: Read the MRI, CSF, neostigmine test and muscle enzyme results

text.zh-CN: 在检查结果回报前，于床旁识别出硫胺素缺乏（第一次即答对）
text.en: Recognised thiamine deficiency at the bedside before any result was back (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 在调阅MRI之前，依据床旁表现开始注射维生素B1
text.en: Started thiamine by injection on the bedside picture, before reading the MRI

text.zh-CN: 选对维生素B1的途径、剂量性质和时机：注射、治疗剂量、先于葡萄糖、不等化验（第一次即答对）
text.en: Chose the right route, dose and timing for thiamine: injected, a treatment dose, before glucose, without waiting for a level (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 在注射维生素B1之前没有输注含葡萄糖的液体
text.en: Gave no glucose-containing infusion before injected thiamine

text.zh-CN: 在注射维生素B1之前，没有改用单纯口服维生素B1，也没有先用免疫球蛋白
text.en: Started neither oral-only thiamine nor IVIG ahead of injected thiamine

text.zh-CN: 正确解读入院检查：支持诊断，但说清哪些病因仍未排除（第一次即答对）
text.en: Read the work-up correctly: supportive, with the causes still not excluded named (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 制定安全的补液和喂养方案：监测电解质、吞咽筛查、逐步加量（第一次即答对）
text.en: Planned fluids and feeding safely: electrolytes watched, swallow screened, feeds built up gradually (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 测了床旁血糖、体重和电解质（含镁、磷），做了吞咽筛查并请营养师会诊
text.en: Checked a bedside glucose, his weight and electrolytes with magnesium and phosphate, screened his swallow and involved the dietitian

text.zh-CN: 如实表述临床诊断，继续治疗、查找病因并安排随访（第一次即答对）
text.en: Stated the diagnosis honestly as clinical and planned continued treatment, the search for a cause and follow-up (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 向家属和孩子解释病情、治疗和不确定之处，并核实理解
text.en: Explained the illness, the treatment and the uncertainty to the relative and the boy, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现（Calgary–Cambridge）：先了解家属已经知道什么、最担心什么（还能不能走路、是不是脑子坏了）；用通俗的话说明眼睛、精神和双腿的问题很可能是缺乏维生素B1引起的，原因可能与多年反复呕吐和偏食有关，而且通常可以治疗；解释为什么不等化验结果就打针（化验做不了，延误有风险），为什么先打维生素B1再输葡萄糖；如实说出不确定之处——维生素B1测不了，吉兰-巴雷综合征还在排查之中；说明一般是眼睛先好转、腿恢复得慢，不作“一定完全恢复”的承诺；不责怪家属或孩子挑食，商量吞咽筛查、逐步恢复饮食和营养师的安排；对孩子用简短、安抚的话；最后用回授法确认家属听懂了，并告诉他们出现什么情况要马上叫人。病历中没有记录与家属的沟通。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge): find out first what the relative already knows and fears most (will he walk again, is his brain damaged); explain in plain words that the problems with his eyes, his alertness and his legs are most likely due to a lack of vitamin B1, probably linked to years of vomiting on and off and his selective eating, and usually treatable; explain why the injections start before any result (the level cannot be measured, and delay is risky) and why the vitamin comes before any glucose drip; be honest about the uncertainty — vitamin B1 cannot be measured, and Guillain–Barré syndrome is still being looked into; explain that the eyes usually improve first and the legs more slowly, without promising a full recovery; do not blame the family or the boy for his eating, and agree the swallow screen, the gradual return of food and the dietitian's role; speak to the boy briefly and reassuringly; end with teach-back and say what should make them call for help at once. The case records no conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 任医生（儿童神经科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 历史病例教学，按阶段推进。用苏格拉底式提问引导学员：眼征、清醒程度下降和双腿无力能不能用一个诊断解释？哪些既往情况会让一个9岁的孩子缺乏硫胺素？为什么不等MRI或血药浓度就治疗？吉兰-巴雷/米勒-费希尔综合征怎样同时排查，什么情况下要做神经传导？恢复进食时要防什么？把报告中的经过（外院按脑炎治疗3天无效）当作历史来讨论；现行做法是床旁一怀疑就注射维生素B1、先于葡萄糖。用PEARLS方式复盘。他的体重、生命体征、血糖、电解质，以及维生素B1的剂量和途径都没有记录，不要替它们补上；不提前透露检查结果、治疗反应或结局。
knowledge.en: A historical teaching case that moves through stages. Use Socratic questions: can the eye signs, the reduced alertness and the leg weakness be one diagnosis? What in his past could leave a 9-year-old short of thiamine? Why treat before the MRI or a level? How are Guillain–Barré and Miller Fisher syndromes pursued alongside, and when are nerve conduction studies needed? What must be guarded against as he starts eating again? Discuss the reported course (three days of encephalitis treatment elsewhere without effect) as history; current practice injects thiamine as soon as it is suspected at the bedside, before any glucose. Debrief in PEARLS order. His weight, vital signs, glucose, electrolytes and the vitamin B1 dose and route are not recorded — never supply them — and do not reveal results, the response to treatment or the outcome early.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士，接收这个孩子入院。交班（ISBAR）：9岁男孩，头晕、复视、双下肢进行性无力6天，现在不能行走，精神越来越差、嗜睡；外院按脑炎治疗3天没有好转；有家属陪同。体重和生命体征没有交过来。可以协助建立静脉通路和采血、测床旁血糖、称体重、做吞咽筛查和定时神经系统观察；在维生素B1给上之前，会提醒学员先别挂含葡萄糖的液体；经口喂食前会建议先做吞咽筛查。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse admitting the boy. Handover (ISBAR): 9-year-old boy with six days of dizziness, double vision and progressive weakness of both legs, now unable to walk and increasingly listless and sleepy; three days of treatment for presumed encephalitis at another hospital have not helped; a relative is with him. No weight or observations have been handed over. Can place a cannula and take bloods, check a bedside glucose, weigh him, screen his swallow and do regular neurological observations; until thiamine has been given, reminds the learner not to hang a glucose-containing drip yet; suggests a swallow screen before anything by mouth.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经调阅的影像报告。可讲解：硫胺素缺乏的典型MRI部位（丘脑内侧、乳头体、导水管周围灰质、第三脑室周围）和主要见于与饮酒无关患者的不典型部位（基底节、小脑、脑神经核团、皮质）；FLAIR和DWI各说明什么；对称性深部灰质病变的鉴别（Leigh综合征、硫胺素转运体缺陷、大脑深静脉血栓、渗透性脱髓鞘、乙型脑炎等病毒性脑炎、缺氧缺血性损伤）；MRI正常不能排除诊断，影像好转也晚于临床。
knowledge.en: Interprets only imaging reports the learner has already read. Can explain the typical MRI sites of thiamine deficiency (medial thalami, mammillary bodies, periaqueductal grey, around the third ventricle) and the atypical sites reported mainly in patients without alcohol use (basal ganglia, cerebellum, cranial nerve nuclei, cortex); what FLAIR and DWI each add; the differential of symmetrical deep grey-matter lesions (Leigh syndrome, thiamine-transporter disorders, deep cerebral venous thrombosis, osmotic demyelination, viral encephalitides such as Japanese encephalitis, hypoxic–ischaemic injury); and that a normal MRI does not exclude the diagnosis, while imaging recovery lags behind the clinical one.

knowledge.zh-CN: 可讲解：维生素B1注射的途径（首选静脉，必要时肌注）以及治疗剂量和补充剂量的区别；儿童剂量按体重计算，所以要先称体重；给药时备好过敏反应急救用品；在任何含葡萄糖的液体之前给药；镁是硫胺素依赖酶的辅因子；口服只用于能进食后的接续治疗；静注人免疫球蛋白的方案和不良反应；甘露醇的利尿作用和对电解质的影响；阿昔洛韦按体重给药并注意肾功能。体重没人量过时，不替学员给出具体毫克数。
knowledge.en: Can explain: the routes for injected thiamine (IV preferred, IM if needed) and the difference between a treatment dose and a supplement; that children's doses go by weight, so he must be weighed; anaphylaxis treatment to hand when it is given; giving it before any glucose-containing fluid; magnesium as a cofactor for thiamine-dependent enzymes; tablets only to continue once he is eating; the IVIG regimen and its adverse effects; mannitol's diuretic and electrolyte effects; aciclovir dosed by weight with attention to renal function. Never gives a milligram dose for a weight nobody has measured.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：9岁孩子的维生素B1缺乏——不只见于饮酒者的韦尼克脑病
title.en: Debrief: vitamin B1 deficiency in a 9-year-old — Wernicke encephalopathy beyond alcohol

conclusion.zh-CN: 9岁男孩头晕、复视、双下肢进行性无力6天，精神越来越差、嗜睡，已不能行走；外院按脑炎治疗3天（用过甘露醇和抗病毒药）无好转。他出生第4天因肠闭锁行部分结肠切除，此后间断呕吐，发病前一周每天呕吐一次，不爱吃肉。查体：双侧上睑下垂，眼球内收、外展受限，水平及垂直眼震；双下肢肌力Ⅲ级，膝反射未引出，病理征阴性，腓肠肌压痛；咽反射稍弱，指鼻试验稳准。MRI示双侧丘脑、豆状核及穹隆对称性异常信号，FLAIR高信号，豆状核DWI稍高；脑脊液常规、生化正常，血常规和肌酶无明显异常，新斯的明试验阴性，维生素B1无法定量。给予维生素B1（剂量和途径未记录）后1周，复视、头晕和眼球运动改善，能走数米；1个月时双下肢肌力Ⅴ级，MRI报告正常。现行答案：临床诊断韦尼克脑病，可能合并硫胺素缺乏性周围神经病；一经怀疑即在任何葡萄糖之前注射治疗剂量的维生素B1，不等化验（EFNS 2010），在监测下逐步恢复营养（ASPEN 2020），并查找病因。
conclusion.en: A 9-year-old boy had six days of dizziness, double vision and progressive leg weakness, grew increasingly listless and sleepy, and could no longer walk; three days of treatment for presumed encephalitis elsewhere (mannitol and an antiviral were used) had not helped. He had vomited on and off since a partial colectomy for intestinal atresia on day 4 of life, once a day in the week before onset, and he did not like meat. He had bilateral ptosis, restricted adduction and abduction, horizontal and vertical nystagmus, leg power grade III, absent knee reflexes with no pathological reflexes, calf tenderness, a slightly weak gag and accurate finger–nose testing. MRI showed symmetrical thalamic, lentiform and fornix signal, high on FLAIR; the CSF, blood count and muscle enzymes showed no obvious abnormality, the neostigmine test was negative and vitamin B1 could not be measured. One week after vitamin B1 (dose and route not recorded) his double vision, dizziness and eye movements had improved and he could walk a few metres; at one month his leg power was grade V and the MRI was reported normal. Today's answer: a clinical diagnosis of Wernicke encephalopathy, probably with a thiamine-deficiency neuropathy, treated on suspicion with injected thiamine before any glucose (EFNS 2010), with monitored refeeding (ASPEN 2020) and a search for the cause.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先把线索拼起来再看片子：眼征、清醒程度下降，加上一个缺乏硫胺素的理由，就构成一个可治疗的诊断——韦尼克脑病并不只见于饮酒者。
keyReasoning.en: Put the pieces together before the scan: eye signs, reduced alertness and a reason to be thiamine-deficient make one treatable diagnosis — Wernicke encephalopathy is not only a disease of alcohol.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 双腿讲的是第二个故事：无力伴膝反射消失和腓肠肌压痛提示周围神经病变——最可能来自同一种缺乏，也正是吉兰-巴雷和米勒-费希尔综合征需要一直保留在鉴别中的原因。
keyReasoning.en: The legs tell a second story: weakness with absent knee reflexes and tender calves points to a peripheral neuropathy — most likely from the same deficiency, and the reason Guillain–Barré and Miller Fisher syndromes stay on the list.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 化验做不了时，治疗就是检验：一个安全、便宜、紧急的治疗立即开始，再把反应当作证据来衡量。
keyReasoning.en: When the test cannot be done, the treatment becomes the test: a safe, cheap and urgent treatment starts at once, and the response is then weighed as evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 顺序很重要：维生素B1在葡萄糖之前，恢复进食时盯住电解质——最初的热量可能让缺乏更重。
keyReasoning.en: Order matters: thiamine before glucose, and electrolytes watched as feeding restarts, because the first calories can make the deficiency worse.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 把证明了的和假设的分开：好转支持硫胺素缺乏，但缺乏的程度和机制（呕吐、饮食还是当年的手术）都没有测定。
keyReasoning.en: Separate what was shown from what was assumed: the improvement supports thiamine deficiency, but neither the level nor the mechanism (vomiting, diet or the old operation) was measured.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个历史病例报告，不能据此比较疗效或推断发病率。1.1.0版的患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；报告没有给出（或1.0.0版没有提取）维生素B1的剂量和途径、体重、生命体征和实验室数值，因此本例不能用来核对任何剂量。诊断是临床诊断：没有测得维生素B1水平，结肠切除与缺乏之间的关系也未经证实。决策、处置选项和评分是依据现行指南的教学设计，不是报告中团队的做法。
boundaries.en: This is a single historical case report: it cannot compare treatments or estimate how common the condition is. Version 1.1.0 keeps the patient facts version 1.0.0 extracted from the report, not yet checked against the full article; the vitamin B1 dose and route, his weight, vital signs and laboratory values are not recorded here, so no dose can be checked against this case. The diagnosis is clinical: no vitamin B1 level was measured, and the link between the colectomy and the deficiency is unproven. The decisions, management options and scoring are teaching design based on current guidance, not what the reporting team did.

unknowns.zh-CN: 体重、身高、生长和营养状况（无法按体重核对任何剂量）。
unknowns.en: His weight, height, growth and nutritional state (so no weight-based dose can be checked).

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征、意识评分、床旁血糖、电解质（含镁、磷）、血气和乳酸；脑脊液和血液检查的具体数值。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, a conscious-level score, bedside glucose, electrolytes (including magnesium and phosphate), blood gas and lactate; the individual CSF and blood values.

unknowns.zh-CN: 维生素B1的剂量、途径、次数和疗程，是否同时补充其他维生素；入院前后输过哪些液体、是否含葡萄糖。
unknowns.en: The vitamin B1 dose, route, frequency and duration, and whether other vitamins were given; which fluids he received before and after admission, and whether they contained glucose.

unknowns.zh-CN: 外院所用抗病毒药的名称、甘露醇和抗病毒药的剂量，以及外院诊断脑炎的依据。
unknowns.en: The name of the antiviral, the doses of the mannitol and the antiviral, and how encephalitis was diagnosed at the other hospital.

unknowns.zh-CN: 神经传导和肌电图、抗神经节苷脂抗体和脑脊液病原学检测；上肢肌力、感觉、踝反射、瞳孔和眼底。
unknowns.en: Nerve conduction studies and EMG, anti-ganglioside antibodies and CSF pathogen tests; upper-limb power, sensation, ankle reflexes, pupils and fundi.

unknowns.zh-CN: 新生儿期手术的细节（切除范围、是否累及小肠）和长期呕吐的原因。
unknowns.en: The details of the neonatal operation (extent of resection, any small-bowel involvement) and the cause of the long-standing vomiting.

unknowns.zh-CN: 1个月以后的病程：神经功能、记忆和学习，以及呕吐和饮食问题是否得到处理。
unknowns.en: The course after one month: neurological function, memory and learning, and whether the vomiting and diet were addressed.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 与饮酒无关也要想到它（EFNS 2010）：指南要求在任何可能导致硫胺素缺乏的情况下都要想到韦尼克脑病。它为饮酒者制定的标准——饮食缺乏、眼征、小脑体征、意识改变或轻度记忆障碍四项中具备两项——放到这个孩子身上同样适用：眼征（上睑下垂、眼外肌麻痹、眼震）和意识改变（精神差、嗜睡）都有记录，饮食缺乏虽未测定但很可能存在（自婴儿期起时常呕吐、发病前每天呕吐、偏食）。在儿童身上，这些标准是提醒，不是门槛。
teachingPoints.en: Suspect it outside alcohol (EFNS 2010): the guideline asks for Wernicke encephalopathy to be suspected in any condition that can lead to thiamine deficiency. Its criteria for people who drink — two of dietary deficiency, eye signs, cerebellar signs and an altered mental state or mild memory impairment — fit this boy: eye signs (ptosis, ophthalmoplegia, nystagmus) and an altered mental state (listless, somnolent) are recorded, and a dietary deficiency is likely though unmeasured (vomiting on and off since infancy, daily before onset, selective eating). In a child the criteria are a prompt, not a gate.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 怀疑即治疗（EFNS 2010）：在任何碳水化合物之前给予硫胺素，用治疗剂量、首选静脉（成人200 mg、每日3次）；能检测时在首剂前即刻留血样测血硫胺素，但绝不等结果。儿童剂量按体重外推，需先称体重并与药师核对。入院前按脑炎治疗3天、维生素B1剂量和途径未记录，是这个孩子的病史；现行做法是在床旁给出首剂。
teachingPoints.en: Treat on suspicion (EFNS 2010): thiamine before any carbohydrate, at a treatment dose, preferably IV (adults 200 mg three times daily); measure blood thiamine on a sample taken just before the first dose where the test exists, but never wait for it. Children's doses are extrapolated by weight — weigh the child and check with the pharmacist. The three days of encephalitis treatment before admission, and the unrecorded vitamin B1 dose and route, are this boy's history; current practice gives the first dose at the bedside.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: MRI是支持而不是裁决（EFNS 2010）：指南建议在饮酒和不饮酒的患者中都用MRI来支持诊断。典型病灶在丘脑内侧、乳头体、顶盖和导水管周围区域，基底节等不典型部位主要见于与饮酒无关的患者（Zuccoli和Pipitone 2009）——他的丘脑、豆状核和穹隆信号与此相符，1个月时MRI报告已正常。MRI正常永远不能排除诊断。
teachingPoints.en: MRI supports, it does not decide (EFNS 2010): the guideline recommends MRI to support the diagnosis in people who drink and in those who do not. Typical lesions lie in the medial thalami, mammillary bodies, tectal plate and periaqueductal area, while atypical sites such as the basal ganglia are reported mainly without alcohol (Zuccoli and Pipitone 2009) — his thalamic, lentiform and fornix signal fits, and the scan was reported normal at one month. A normal MRI never rules it out.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 鉴别与正常结果排除不了什么（EAN/PNS 2023；ABN/BPAIIG 2012）：眼肌麻痹加腱反射消失也是米勒-费希尔综合征的特征，指南建议此时检测抗GQ1b抗体；支持吉兰-巴雷综合征诊断的是电生理检查，而不是正常的脑脊液——早期脑脊液蛋白可以正常；免疫球蛋白用于起病2周内不能独立行走的吉兰-巴雷综合征。新斯的明试验阴性使重症肌无力的可能变小；按ABN/BPAIIG 2012，免疫功能正常的儿童作出其他诊断后即可停用阿昔洛韦。
teachingPoints.en: Mimics, and what normal results cannot exclude (EAN/PNS 2023; ABN/BPAIIG 2012): ophthalmoplegia with areflexia also marks Miller Fisher syndrome, for which the guideline advises anti-GQ1b antibodies, and electrodiagnostic testing — not a normal CSF, whose protein can be normal early — supports Guillain–Barré syndrome; IVIG is for Guillain–Barré syndrome that stops a patient walking unaided within 2 weeks of onset. A negative neostigmine test makes myasthenia less likely; the ABN/BPAIIG 2012 guideline lets aciclovir stop in an immunocompetent child once an alternative diagnosis is made.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 安全地恢复喂养（ASPEN 2020）。没有体重和摄入量，无法给他的再喂养风险分级，所以先按有风险处理：ASPEN对有风险的儿童在开始喂养或输含葡萄糖液体之前补充硫胺素，喂养前查钾、镁、磷并在最初3天反复监测，热量从低于目标量开始逐步增加。镁是硫胺素依赖酶的辅因子，低镁要纠正。咽反射稍弱时，经口进食前先做吞咽筛查。
teachingPoints.en: Refeed safely (ASPEN 2020). His refeeding risk cannot be graded without a weight or an intake, so treat him as at risk: ASPEN gives an at-risk child thiamine before feeds or dextrose-containing fluid, checks potassium, magnesium and phosphate before feeding and repeatedly over the first 3 days, and starts energy below goal, building up gradually. Magnesium is a cofactor for thiamine-dependent enzymes, so correct a low level. With a slightly weak gag, screen the swallow before anything by mouth.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 如实命名诊断并处理病因：没有测得水平，这是由治疗反应支持的临床诊断，不是实验室确诊。硫胺素主要在空肠吸收，部分结肠切除本身证明不了吸收不良（是否累及小肠没有记录）；多年间断呕吐和偏食是更直接的原因，需要外科、消化科和营养师评估，并随访神经功能、记忆和学习。
teachingPoints.en: Name the diagnosis honestly and treat the cause: with no level measured, this is a clinical diagnosis supported by the response, not laboratory proof. Thiamine is absorbed mainly in the jejunum, so a partial colectomy alone does not prove malabsorption (whether his small bowel was involved is not recorded); years of intermittent vomiting and selective eating are the more direct causes and need surgical, gastroenterology and dietetic review, with follow-up of nerve function, memory and learning.

unknowns.en: The details of the neonatal operation (extent of resection, any small-bowel involvement) and the cause of the long-standing vomiting.

unknowns.zh-CN: 1个月以后的病程：神经功能、记忆和学习，以及呕吐和饮食问题是否得到处理。
unknowns.en: The course after one month: neurological function, memory and learning, and whether the vomiting and diet were addressed.

testUtterances.text: 孩子怎么了，病了几天了？
Tell me what's been going on with him.
What brings you in today?
看东西是不是有两个影子？
Are you seeing two of everything?
头是不是晕乎乎的？
Is your head spinning at all?
腿现在还能站起来走吗？
腿有没有劲？
When did his legs start giving way, and can he walk now?
他最近是不是特别能睡，叫都叫不醒？
Has he been more drowsy than usual?
Is he very sleepy?
在别的医院是怎么给他处理的？
之前在哪看过？
What did the last hospital do for him, and did it work?
Has he been treated anywhere else?
那边给他用了些什么药？
Which drugs did they put him on over there?
这次病之前那几天有没有吐？
Was he throwing up in the days before this started?
他是不是一直以来就容易吐？
Has he always been a vomiter since the surgery?
他吃饭挑不挑？肉吃不吃？
平时吃饭怎么样？
What does he normally eat — does he have meat?
小时候动过什么手术没有？
Any operations when he was a baby?
以前得过什么病？
Any past medical history?
对青霉素之类的药过敏吗？
Is he allergic to anything?
家族里有没有人得过神经方面的病？
Does anything like this run in the family?
前段时间发烧感冒过没有？
Any fever or tummy bug beforehand?
喝水会不会呛着？
Does he choke when he drinks?
大便怎么样？
Has he lost weight lately?
腿麻不麻？
Has he had pins and needles in his legs?
他平时吃什么保健品或者维生素吗？
Does he take any vitamins regularly?
有没有输过葡萄糖？
Was there glucose in his drips?
您最担心的是哪一点？
What are you most worried about?
这一周下来他好些没有？
Is he any better since starting the treatment?
满一个月了，腿恢复得怎么样？
How's he getting on now, a month down the line?
他的血压和心率是多少？
他上几年级了？
他头疼不疼？
Can I see the report from the scan?
Is he up to date with his vaccinations?
